purpose: Evaluator-only input inventory for the six known regression projects.

policy.TEXT: Prepared MD is authoritative; never re-extract or override TEXT from PDF raster.
policy.GRAPHIC: PDF and block geometry support graphic review; file presence does not prove each required graphic has been read.
policy.questions: Separate questions and clarifications section, as explicitly chosen by the user.
policy.external_sources: Manufacturer and normative evidence are not proven available merely because primary MD/PDF exist. Declare permitted sources before scoring those targets.
policy.blindness: This inventory contains target IDs and is evaluator-only. Discovery receives only separately prepared source files and approved instructions.
policy.same_input: Use identical source hashes and permitted supplementary sources for baseline and candidate.
policy.exposure: All six projects are previously known regression cases, never new blind validation.
